decisions.reason: The existing message-210 MODIFY already captures the on-chain ticket association with the NFT mint number and wallet and its dashboard display.

The existing message-210 MODIFY already records the ticket's on-chain association with the holder's NFT mint number and wallet; dashboard presentation remains owned by the source visibility Requirement.
This candidate governs dashboard visibility of referral commissions, which is unchanged by the separate decision to expose prize-ticket accounting.
The source does not require a change to NFT metadata fields, and the existing state already includes the Small Block ticket counter.
Individual ticket association and dashboard visibility do not change the public countdown's text, measure, prize amount, or 100-sale interval.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already updates the About-page process copy with the on-chain ticket mechanism; the dashboard accounting detail does not necessarily alter this page.
Prize-ticket accounting visibility does not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, limit, or payout mode.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already captures the recurring-prize and referral-ticket copy relevant to the Mission page; dashboard ticket visibility requires no additional page-state change.
Associating and displaying earned tickets does not alter the VRF provider, draw execution, fairness property, or winner-selection mechanism.
The wallet-provisioning state already covers the provisioned wallet holding rewards and dashboard/SIWE access; ticket visibility introduces no new provisioning behavior.
Ticket accounting visibility does not change the Small Block prize amount, cadence, funding, eligibility rule, or automatic drawing behavior.
Associating a ticket with a mint number does not change the rule that the permanent referral code is the NFT mint number.
